title: A privately signed acceptance — Kendel v. Pontious
shortTitle: A privately signed acceptance — Kendel v. Pontious
summary: The notes describe signing an agreement without immediately communicating it to the other party.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

Did the offer make execution alone sufficient, or did it invite a communicated promise? Identify when the act of acceptance and any required notification occurred. Compare private intention with an act placed in a proper course of transmission.

No answer key is supplied in the assigned passage. A cited case may suggest a line of thought; its citation is not treated as the answer.
